prayer: Prayer: Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India to issue a writ of Habeas Corpus to call for the records pertaining to the impugned detention order passed by the second respondent in his Detention Order Cr.M.P. No. 43 of 2025 dated 08.09.2025, quash the same and produce the person or body of the detenue S. Kulanthaivel, S/o. Shanmugam, aged about 47 years presently confined at Central Prison, Madurai, before this Court.
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

N. Anand Venkatesh, J.:— When the matter was taken up for hearing, the learned counsel for the petitioner as well as the Additional Public Prosecutor, by producing a proceeding in G.O.Rt. No. 6898 Home, Prohibition and Excise (XIV) Department dated 24.10.2025 submitted that the detention order has already been revoked. Recording the said submission, this Habeas Corpus Petition is closed.
